caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic pitcher or coffee pot, rendered in shades of gray and black, centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The vessel has a tall, cylindrical body that widens slightly toward the base, which is circular and ringed by two horizontal lines. The spout is long and curves outward from the left side near the top. The handle, attached at the upper and lower right, features a pronounced and ornate S-shaped curve. The lid of the pitcher is dome-shaped, topped by a finial with three stacked, rounded elements. The drawing is composed using fine, smooth shading to indicate the reflective metallic surface and contours of the pitcher. At the bottom right, outside the border, the name "Charles Cullen" is written in cursive.
title: Pewter Flagon
